title: onprem: onprem airgap offline bundle - vendor rke2 almalinux/rocky support + rollback tooling
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Adds vendor support for RKE2 offline bundles targeting AlmaLinux 9 and Rocky 9, plus installer-side rollback tooling and small Helm chart updates. Motivation: several enterprise customers requested RKE2 bundles for AlmaLinux/Rocky due to corporate OS standardization and need for air-gapped installs. This PR bundles the distro artifacts, adds installer detection and package mapping, and introduces a tested rollback path for failed upgrades in air-gapped environments. Checklist: - [x] Vendor tarballs + manifests added - [x] Installer distro detection and mapping implemented - [x] Rollback scripts and idempotency checks added - [x] Helm chart values for offline-bundle updated - [x] Integration tests (offline install + upgrade + rollback) added - [x] Documentation snippets updated. Notes: the vendor tarballs are stored in the offline-bundle/ vendors directory (no upstream network calls). Rollback is implemented by preserving previous helm release payloads and image bundles on ephemeral storage and provides a deterministic restore path. See linked Linear ENG-1742 for testing matrix and customer requests.
commits: vendor: add rke2-almalinux9 and rke2-rocky9 tarballs + manifests
installer: detect AlmaLinux/Rocky platform and map package lists to RKE2 bundle
scripts: add rollback/restore helper and idempotency checks
charts: offline-bundle helm values and templates updated for distro selectors
tests: add integration test for airgap upgrade + rollback scenario
docs: update onprem installer README with distro support and rollback steps
review_comments: Aaron Chen: Can we avoid duplicating the kernel module packages between almalinux and rocky bundles? Suggest centralizing common files to reduce bundle size.
Priya Natarajan (author): Good point — I split common libs into bundles/shared/ and updated manifests to reference shared.tar.gz. This reduced total bundle size by ~12%.
María Gómez: Rollback script looks good but please add a safety timeout and a dry-run mode. Also confirm behavior when disk space is low.

Priya Natarajan: Added --dry-run mode and a disk-space preflight check that aborts with a clear error. See scripts/rollback/rollback.sh lines added in commit 'scripts: add rollback/restore helper and idempotency checks'.
Liam Park: CI flakes on integration test previously, re-run passed — can we pin the test to a smaller image to reduce runtime in CI?
Priya Natarajan: Integration test now uses cached local images for CI and falls back to minimal distroless images for faster runs. Verified on CI run #4721.
